description: This file defines a Catalyst plugin role in Perl that sets the HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) header in HTTP responses, with configurable options such as max-age, includeSubDomains, and preload.

classes.name: Coocook::Plugin::StrictTransportSecurity
classes.description: A Catalyst plugin role that adds HTTP Strict Transport Security headers to responses based on configuration.

methods.name: after prepare_action
methods.description: A method modifier that executes after the 'prepare_action' method, setting the HSTS header if conditions are met.
